title: Goat Yoga in The Patch @ Bedford Public Library!
description: Goat Yoga in The Patch @ Bedford Public Library!
long_description:
Come and join us for Goat Yoga in The Patch hosted by the Bedford Public Library!

About this Event 
 https://cdn-az.allevents.in/events2/banners/dcb6ced0-87e3-11f1-b6c8-ef4137d8dcb0-rimg-w663-h740-dca7c3f1-gmir.jpg 

YOU are invited to GOAT YOGA in BEDFORD, TX! Come and get your yoga on while our tribe of pet goats graze and jump around (or on) you! We will be in the pumpkin patch at the Bedford Public Library! Come as you are or dressed up in Halloween costume attire. The goats will be in costume!
Please come dressed for the weather as the event will be outside. Proceeds from this class directly benefit our animals and our local non-profit initiatives. 

Know before you go:
*Please do not enter the fenced off goat yoga area any earlier than 15 minutes before your scheduled class time. We will set aside time after class for extra socializing and picture taking with the goats if you don't get the shot you want during yoga practice.
 *BYOM (bring your own yoga mat) We do not provide mats, but we do provide beach towels for all attendees to use. We also provide bottled waters, sunscreen, bug spray, etc.
*Be prepared for our goats to take an interest in you! They are excited to be with you! Goat yoga is for everyone, and we welcome participants age 5 and over (with a participating parent or guardian). It is meant to be fun and memorable. Goats have been known to nudge, scratch, nibble, jump and step on attendees. Goats are NOT potty trained animals. There will be a sanitizing station and antibacterial wipes available.
*Everyone will need to check in and sign our liability waiver before the class starts. Masks are not required. This is an outdoor fitness event. Social distancing will be the responsibility of each participant in regards to their own preferences in proximity to other attendees.

Our tribe looks forward to meeting you!

Let us know if you have any questions or if we can provide you with any additional information - we look forward to hosting you!
